hypothesis: Past-only deterministic first/second positional differences permit same-capacity ordinary neural networks to learn true real-action state effects that raw history networks miss, even though both contain exactly the same upstream observations.
null: If derived-feature MLP/GRU fail every-seed accuracy and sham controls, feature access is not shown to be the binding bottleneck. Frozen failures preserved, no retuning after viewing outcomes.

data.actual_source_sister_intervention: a0 and a1 on two really executed identical-prefix physical source engines, followed by same seven actually executed actions; all actual outcomes and terminations retained
data.raw_observer_input: past 8 rows × 6 continuous values: cart x, zeroed true cart velocity, pole angle, zeroed true angular velocity, previous actually executed action, previous observed reward. No future data; no true velocity.
data.feature_observer_input: exact same original 8×6 history PLUS four deterministic past-only source position features per row: backward cart difference/dt, backward pole difference/dt, backward cart second difference/dt², backward pole second difference/dt²; i=0 first differences set 0, i<2 second differences set 0. DT=0.02 source-pinned. Both arms padded to identical 8×10 shape.
data.normalizer: Per input channel training-source mean and std only; shared raw-channel scaling identical between raw/derived, derived channels normalized using train-only; no validation/test fit. Std floor 1e-4. All normalization and feature hashes archived.
data.sham: Same derived neural architecture, seed/init, epochs/update budget and true action consequences; for EACH training epoch independently shuffle the four derived feature channels across train samples while preserving each sample's original raw 6 channels and true outcome. Evaluate on truthful derived features.
data.forbidden_control: Global sign flip of engineered derivatives throughout train and evaluation is invertible, NOT a causal negative; never claim otherwise.
data.source_oracle: Source length passed only to a separately identified privileged length-to-effect regression diagnostic; not into any eligible model or input normalizer.

training.MLP_architecture: 8×10 ->32 -> Tanh ->16 -> Tanh ->2 for effect, output 1 for separately trained length diagnostic
training.GRU_architecture: continuous 10 features with GRU hidden size9, last output linear to observed effect 2
training.initialization: Identical initial weights per seed for raw/derived/sham within same family, same randomized train minibatch indices and fixed train epoch; no best test epoch selected.
training.compare_eligible_conventional: Original fixed-fit factual public-history ridge from P28 using only train source actual positions, past differences and actions; no extra source length/privileged inputs.

predeclared.metric: factual 8-step source paired action-effect MSE on each completely unseen heldout length, lower is better; source physics varied by original engine parameters only
predeclared.strongest_conventional_architectural_sup: requires each derived neural architecture MSE <=0.9* fully trained original visible-feature ridge on both heldout conditions ALL model seeds with matched whole-process costs; otherwise do not claim superiority
